# Badge

A short label for a status, category or count, next to what it describes.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Brand expressive</span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-badge--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:brand-expressive;mode:light" title="Badge examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-badge--docs">Open Badge in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-badge--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:brand-expressive;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

**In Brand expressive:** New and limited labels.

- **Use it when:** A state people scan for in a list or table, or a small category label.
- **Not when:** A message people must read (alert or toast), or an action (a button).

Instead:

- [Alert](./alert.md): A message, not a label.
- [Button](./button.md): Something to press.

## How Brand expressive uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">A status</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> Badge pill with a word</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> Color alone</div></div><div class="cap">A word keeps meaning on vivid backgrounds.</div></div><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">Shape of a status badge</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> radius.badge (pill)</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> A rectangle</div></div><div class="cap">Pills match the controls.</div></div></div>

## Why it works this way

Badge looks the way it does because of 4 answers about this product. Each card is one answer, in three steps: the answer, what it decided for Badge, and what would move if it changed.

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-accessibility-count"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How many signals carry each meaning?</b><code>accessibility.count</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Two: color and word</div><p>Color and word.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Badge</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>neutral</b>: New: a label, not a state to fix.</span></li><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>success</b>: On the list: you joined and your place is saved.</span></li><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>warning</b>: Almost gone: few left, act soon.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Alert: destructive</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">3</div><small>Badge decisions would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-content-q1"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What is the main content?</b><code>content.q1</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Images and campaigns</div><p>Images, campaigns and short punchy copy.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Badge</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>info</b>: Campaign labels are a state or a nudge; there are no plain news labels.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Empty: default</code> <code>Input group: block-start</code> <code>Input group: block-end</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Badge decision would reopen</small><p>and 11 answers that follow from it: <b>One idea at a time</b>, <b>Browse and explore</b>, <b>A display face for brand moments, with a sans for text</b>, and 8 more.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-outcomes-q1"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>Which outcome matters most?</b><code>outcomes.q1</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Engagement</div><p>Engagement and sign-ups.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Badge</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>warning</b>: Almost gone: few left, act soon.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: primary</code> <code>Button: large</code> <code>Toast: success</code> <code>Toggle: lg</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Badge decision would reopen</small><p>and 6 answers that follow from it: <b>A few minutes</b>, <b>Brand moments</b>, <b>Hero and launch moments</b>, and 3 more.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-voice-count"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How many tones does it use?</b><code>voice.count</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">One per moment</div><p>Playful in headlines, plain in errors.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Badge</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>danger</b>: Nothing on a launch page is labeled as failed; errors are plain sentences.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Toast: neutral</code> <code>Toast: danger</code> <code>Alert: default</code> <code>Alert: destructive</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Badge decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] The status is a word; color and icon add to it, never replace it. undefined
